Krazy Korner Concert Band Guitars/Basses/Pedals Orchestra Percussion Pro-Audio Milano Merch Our Rental Depots Gift Certificates Sheet Music & Lessons Home Shop Guitars and Amps Effect Pedals Maxon Fuzz Elements Fire Pedal Maxon Fuzz Elements Fire Pedal Maxon SKU: FF10 $169.00 (You save ) Current Stock: Quantity: Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Add to Wish List Create Wish List × Description Fuzz engine based on Vintage Roland AF100 Bee Baa Square Wave clipping with upper octave harmonic Thick, muscular distortion with excellent note definition & clean up Two distinct fuzz tones via Notch footswitch Mechanical True Bypass Switching The AF100 Bee Baa was Roland’s answer to the gnarly, nasty guitar boxes coming out of the USA & the UK in the late 60’s and early 70’s. A combination of transistor Fuzz, Octavia, and Treble Booster, the Bee Baa’s massive metal housing & triple stomp switches provided ample evidence that this pedal was not to be trifled with. Even Maxon was hard-pressed to reproduce the AF100’s might in their compact chassis format. Opting to stick with the Fuzz aspects of the Bee Baa, they decided to leave out the Treble Boost section of the circuit when developing this next Fuzz Elements model. The FF10 Fire produces two distinctly different yet equally aggressive fuzz tones based on the AF100’s signature sounds. In normal mode, the FF10’s three controls can dial in thick & muscular transistor tones akin to a great-sounding Big Muff, but with improved midrange response and superior note clarity & clean-up. Activating the Notch switch scoops mids & accentuates the upper octave harmonics dramatically, creating sizzling, searing sustained tones that are perfect for lead work. As on the original AF100, Maxon kept the Notch setting foot switchable, allowing the user to toggle between these two titanic tones in mid-song. Smaller & less expensive, but just as effective as the original it was inspired by: Fuzz Elements Fire brings the heat.
